ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) pixels across the central fluke surface with high-intensity (white) pixel bands concentrated along the leading edges and distal tips; estimated dark-to-light ratio of 4:1.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous dark (black) region occupying the central 80% of the visible surface; high-contrast white bands mapped along the peripheral margins of both lobes, expanding into broader white patches at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression at the center-point with an approximate internal angle of 75 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Visible serration along the trailing edge boundary; characterized by low-frequency, irregular pixel-amplitude peaks most prominent on the outer thirds of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping convex curves from the median notch transitioning into tapered, swept-back distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast white pixel clusters located on the distal tips of both the left and right lobes, consistent with localized scarring.

other_distinctive_markers: Water spray and surface turbulence pixels obscuring the base of the fluke at the peduncle junction.
